gloss: job offer; job opening; help wanted

definitions.explanation: A position that an employer is seeking to fill; the act of recruiting employees.

examples.japanese: {求人|きゅうじん}サイトで{仕事|しごと}を{探|さが}す。
examples.english: Look for a job on a job listing site.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{求人|きゅうじん}{募集|ぼしゅう}をしている。
examples.english: This store is recruiting for staff.

examples.japanese: {求人|きゅうじん}{広告|こうこく}を{見|み}て{応募|おうぼ}した。
examples.english: I saw a job advertisement and applied.

notes:
{求人|きゅうじん} is a compound: {求|きゅう} (seek) + {人|じん} (person).

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {求人|きゅうじん}{広告|こうこく} (job advertisement)
- {求人|きゅうじん}{情報|じょうほう} (job information)
- {求人|きゅうじん}サイト (job listing website)
- {求人|きゅうじん}{倍率|ばいりつ} (job-to-applicant ratio)
- {求人|きゅうじん}{募集|ぼしゅう} (job recruitment)

CONTRAST:
- {求人|きゅうじん} (employer seeking workers)
- {求職|きゅうしょく} (worker seeking employment)

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- ハローワーク (Hello Work - public employment office)
- {転職|てんしょく} (job change)
- {採用|さいよう} (hiring)
